notes:
ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome only. One dedicated tab on www.otto.de; the whole extraction ran as same-origin fetch() calls issued from a loaded otto.de page via javascript_tool, paced 450-600ms. ~730 requests in total, every one HTTP 200 - no 403, DataDome, Akamai, CAPTCHA or rate limit at any point. robots.txt re-read: no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot group; the generic User-agent:* group disallows only /gate/, /onex/, /cdn-cgi/ and one hashed path, none of which are category pages.

SCOPE: otto.de is a general marketplace. Only the furniture departments were taken: /moebel/ (Moebel) and /garten/gartenmoebel/ (Gartenmoebel, emitted under category 'Outdoor Furniture'). Everything else (fashion, electronics, appliances, /dekoration/, /heimtextilien/, /lampen/, /baumarkt/) was left alone.

TREE: union of three sources, per the mandatory cross-check. (1) the category sitemap https://www.otto.de/category-sitemap/sitemap_moebel.xml.gz (gzip decompressed in-page with DecompressionStream) -> 335 clean category paths, plus sitemap_garten.xml.gz -> 25 paths under /garten/gartenmoebel/. (2) a BFS closure over every page's own local-navigation widget (li.nav_local-link > .nav_link-title + .nav_link-count[data-count] + a[href]), which lists that node's direct children (or, on a leaf page, its sibling group). 299 nodes were fetched this way, 0 errors. (3) the /moebel/ department page. The sitemap alone was NOT enough - it is missing /moebel/badmoebel/badmoebel-sets/ and /garten/gartenmoebel/balkonmoebel/, both of which only the nav widget exposes.

QTY - the important finding. OTTO's rendered listing header (.reptile-item-count__item-count, 'N Produkte') is PADDED and must not be used as-is: for any category with fewer than roughly 500 products OTTO tops the result set up with similar products and reports the padded number. Proven directly on /moebel/garderoben/wandgarderoben/garderobenhaken/hutablagen/ - h1 'Hutablagen', the site's own nav count is 7, the header reads '500 Produkte', and the page's embedded JSON carries rankedCount 3436 / displayCount 3437, with the 'Warum zeigen wir dir diese Produkte?' expansion hint. Same pattern on Badhocker (247 -> 500), Poufs (399 -> 500), Sitzwuerfel (62 -> 500), Feuerwehrbetten (23 -> 476), Kufenstuehle (20 -> 311). So qty is taken from OTTO's own per-category nav data-count, which is generated from the same live search index. It was validated against the rendered header on all 194 counted leaves: above ~600 products the two agree to within 6% everywhere (Polsterhocker 1033 = 1033, Sofas 75476 vs 75479, Fusshocker 679 vs 676, Barhocker 7160 vs 7213, Bettgestelle 80925 vs 80985), and the only nine disagreements are all sub-500 nodes where the header is the padded number. Counts drift by a fraction of a percent between reads within the session (live inventory).

LEAF VERIFICATION (bad-slug trap): all 202 candidate leaf URLs were re-fetched and checked for HTTP 200 plus rel=canonical identity. All 202 returned 200. Eight of them turned out to be filter/search re-cuts whose canonical is a query URL, and were dropped: Stauraumbetten (-> /moebel/betten/?s=mit-stauraum), Klappbetten (?s=klappbar), Fernsehsessel (?zubehoerfuer=fernseher), Klappstuehle (?s=klappbar), Klapptische (?s=klappbar), Laptoptische (?zubehoerfuer=laptops), Garderobenschraenke (?raum=garderobe-flur), Klapphochstuehle (?s=klappbar). One survivor, /moebel/kommoden-sideboards/kommoden/, canonicalises to its own parent but serves a genuinely different, smaller listing - kept and flagged.

FACET DEPARTMENTS THAT MIRROR THE MAIN TAXONOMY (the trap flagged in the assignment) - all dropped: /moebel/badmoebel/ is not a department, it redirects to /moebel/?raum=badezimmer and its 'children' are ?raum=badezimmer cuts of Schraenke/Tische/Regale/Sofas/etc; /garten/gartenmoebel/balkonmoebel/ canonicalises to /moebel/?raum=balkon; /garten/gartenmoebel/loungemoebel/ redirects to /moebel/?s=lounge and its Lounge-Sets (51779) is essentially the same population as Gartenmoebel-Sets (51860); /moebel/regale/regalwuerfel/ canonicalises to /moebel/regale/?s=wuerfel; /moebel/kindermoebel/ and /moebel/babyzimmer/ are room roll-ups whose children are ?altersgruppe= facets. Inside /garten/gartenmoebel/ the nav entries Gartensessel, Gartenliegen, Gartenbaenke, Gartensofas, Gartenhocker are likewise ?raum=garten cuts of the indoor tree and were dropped; only the real path children were kept. Bathroom furniture is still represented - Badmoebel-Sets is a real node, and the actual bathroom furniture types (Spiegelschraenke, Waschbeckenunterschraenke, Hoch-/Midi-/Unter-/Haengeschraenke, Badhocker) sit under Schraenke/Hocker and are emitted there.

OTHER EXCLUSIONS: /moebel/zubehoer/ (74 nodes of furniture parts - legs, castors, handles, fittings, shelf inserts, bed slats), /moebel/messlatten/ (height charts), /moebel/halterungen/ (TV/wall mounts), /moebel/premium-moebel/ (price/brand re-cut), /moebel/inspiration/. /moebel/truhen/ was dropped because its rel=canonical is /dekoration/aufbewahrung/truhen/ - it belongs to the Decoration > Storage department, not furniture. Material/style re-cuts dropped per the rules: Rattanstuehle, Chesterfield-Sofas, Chesterfield-Sessel, Stoffschraenke, Baumkantentische, Mosaiktische, Ledersofas. Textiles and covers dropped: Gartenmoebel-Auflagen and its 3 children, Gartenmoebel-Schutzhuellen and its 6 children, Babybettausstattung, Outdoor-Kissen. Standalone storage dropped: Auflagenboxen (cushion boxes), Spielzeugkisten. Hardware dropped: the whole Wandgarderoben hooks-and-rails branch (Garderobenhaken, Kleiderhaken, Tuerhaken, Klapphaken, Hutablagen, Garderobenleisten, Garderobenstangen) - only Garderobenpaneele was kept, flagged as ambiguous. Luftbetten (air mattresses) dropped as bedding. Accessory sub-nodes under Hochstuehle (Sitzverkleinerer, Zubehoer, Auflagen) dropped.

GROUP vs LEAF: applied the numerical test. Where a node's children genuinely partition it (children sum >= ~60% of the parent and are distinct product types) the parent is a grouping row. Where the children are overlapping form/shape re-cuts covering only a fraction, the PARENT is kept as the leaf and the slivers are dropped - this is why Kommoden (44% covered), Nachttische (6.5%), Kleiderschraenke (35%), Sitzbaenke (24%), Couchtische (0.1%), Esstische (6%), Buecherregale (<1%), Wandregale (29%), TV-Boards (<1%) and XXL-Sofas (10%) are leaves rather than grouping rows. Each of those carries a flag stating the coverage.
